source: Armor core 170,000 is data/td2/attributes.json (ProtoTrack / community table, 2026-11-01). Piece base armor is the level-40 datamine posted by D3LTAFR0ST on r/thedivision, 17 Oct 2020 (Mask 80,297, Chest 157,961, Holster 111,889, Kneepads 98,726, Gloves 80,297, Backpack 130,844). Expertise is Ubisoft's Intelligence Annex: weapons +1% weapon damage per rank to the weapon's own damage bonus, gear +1% of that piece's base armor per rank, not of the blue core (https://www.ubisoft.com/en-us/game/the-division/the-division-2/news-updates/3Eqa62fOd4sDI1hqjSVdI2/intelligence-annex-expertise). Rank cap 30 is the Year 8 prototype requirement in the builder spec. Base health is not in those sources, so it is null and the sheet shows health percent and flat health separately.
